protocol:
1. Arrange a labeled strip of small PCR tubes in a white tube rack on the bench, with the tube caps opened and facing upward.

2. Position the open PCR tubes so the handwritten cap labels are visible and aligned for pipetting.

3. Attach a 20 µL pipette tip from the pink tip rack to an adjustable micropipette.

4. Dispense clear liquid with the micropipette into the first open labeled PCR tube.

5. Aspirate clear liquid from the plastic beaker/reservoir using the same micropipette and 20 µL tip.

6. Dispense the clear liquid into the next open labeled PCR tube in the rack.

7. Repeat the aspiration from the plastic beaker/reservoir with the micropipette.

8. Dispense the clear liquid into the third open labeled PCR tube.

9. Repeat the aspiration of clear liquid from the plastic beaker/reservoir.

10. Dispense the clear liquid into the fourth open labeled PCR tube.

11. Place a Petri dish containing pink liquid near the tube rack while the PCR tubes remain open in the rack.

12. Reposition the tube rack on the bench to align the open PCR tubes for closing.

13. Close the caps on the labeled PCR tubes by pressing each cap down into its tube.

14. Leave the capped labeled PCR tubes seated upright in the tube rack on the bench.
